## PackageConstructorParameters interface

Configuration parameters for constructing a package instance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface PackageConstructorParameters 
```

## Remarks

This interface defines the required configuration for creating an instance of [Package](./xpm-lib.package.md)<!-- -->. Both properties are mandatory.

The parameters provide the absolute path to the package folder containing (or that will contain) the <code>package.json</code> file, and the logger for diagnostic output during package operations.
